questions.question: Task actions
questions.answer: Start: create a terminal tile and launch an agent, or prompt the built-in ACP chat panel. Steer: type into the terminal or chat. Stop: cancel the ACP prompt or close the terminal. sources.title: README.md
sources.finding: Early-stage Electron desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux. Independent sidecar PTYs, local files, editable Markdown/code tiles and local JSON state. No account required; PostHog anonymous usage analytics.

sources.title: LICENSE.md
sources.finding: Application uses Functional Source License 1.1 with Apache-2.0 future license. Competing commercial uses are restricted before the future-license conversion.

sources.title: Collaborator 0.8.4
sources.finding: Collaborator 0.8.4 was published 2026-06-16. Release notes describe the scoped changes; this is not a hands-on check.

sources.title: Collab homepage (collaborator.bot redirect)
sources.finding: collaborator.bot redirects to a 'Collab' page in closed beta with an early-access sign-up and no pricing.

sources.title: Collaborator README: install and overview
sources.locator: README.md lines 11-19 (Install) and line 65 (Application overview), commit 476b8ef
sources.finding: Desktop builds for macOS, Windows and Linux download from GitHub releases or a shell install script; the app works on local files with no account required. No price or paid plan is named.

sources.title: Collaborator LICENSE.md
sources.locator: LICENSE.md lines 1-45 (FSL-1.1-ALv2 header, grant and Permitted Purpose), commit 476b8ef
sources.finding: The software is under the Functional Source License 1.1 with Apache-2.0 future license, which permits use, copying and redistribution for any purpose other than a Competing Use, with no fee stated.

sources.title: collaborator: collab-electron/src/main/pty.ts
sources.locator: PTY launch; src/main/config.ts, json-rpc-server.ts, analytics.ts, integrations.ts; CLI and tile/persistence models
sources.finding: Pinned Electron main/renderer source implements local PTY terminals and local JSON canvas/tile state. The native app has no remote execution backend, released browser/mobile client, shared-user account service, role/SSO system, issue store, task scheduler, PR API or workspace/container/VM provisioning. PostHog analytics initializes from a build-time key with no user opt-out control. Generic shell access does not prove named harness integration.

sources.title: collaborator: collab-electron/packages/collab-canvas-skill/skills/collab-canvas/SKILL.md
sources.locator: Agent in a terminal; terminal write/read; integrations.ts; cli/collab-cli.mjs
sources.finding: The shipped canvas skill instructs an agent to create a terminal, launch Claude Code with a delegated prompt and read its result. The installed CLI controls canvas terminals over local JSON-RPC. integrations.ts detects Claude Code, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI and installs their canvas instructions. Terminals run the user shell with its normal environment and agent login.

sources.title: collab-electron/package.json
sources.finding: Version 0.8.4, license FSL-1.1-ALv2; electron-builder publishes to GitHub releases of collabs-inc/collab-public; targets macOS zip (arm64, x64), Windows NSIS (x64, arm64) and Linux AppImage (x64).

sources.title: collab-electron/cli/collab-cli.mjs
sources.finding: Product-owned collab-canvas CLI with tile list/create/rm/move/resize/focus, terminal write/read and browser navigate/screenshot/snapshot/click/type/scroll/eval/wait/info subcommands, sent as JSON-RPC to a local socket.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/cli-installer.ts
sources.finding: The app installs a collab-canvas wrapper into ~/.local/bin (collab-canvas.cmd on Windows).

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/canvas-rpc.ts
sources.finding: Registers canvas.tile*, canvas.terminalWrite/Read, canvas.viewport* and canvas.browser* RPC methods forwarded to the shell window.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/json-rpc-server.ts
sources.finding: Newline-delimited JSON-RPC server on a local socket whose path is written to ~/.collaborator/socket-path; no token or user check appears in the handler.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/ipc-misc.ts
sources.finding: RPC methods let an external agent hook report session start, files read or written and session end (shown on the workspace graph), and app.notify shows a native desktop notification on request.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/acp-agent.ts
sources.finding: Built-in agent chat panel speaks the Agent Client Protocol to the bundled claude-agent-acp package with ACP_PERMISSION_MODE=acceptEdits, automatically selects the allow_once option for permission requests, prompts, cancels and resumes the saved session id.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/windows/shell/src/renderer.js
sources.finding: The shell hosts the agent-chat webview (cwd ~/.collaborator) as a side panel.

sources.title: collab-electron/packages/collab-canvas-skill/skills/collab-canvas/SKILL.md
sources.finding: Shipped skill tells a controlling agent to create a terminal tile, run claude -p with a prompt via terminal write and read the output back with terminal read.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/integrations.ts
sources.finding: Named integrations exist only for Claude Code, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI: detection by ~/.claude, ~/.codex, ~/.gemini or PATH and install of the canvas skill or instruction file.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/analytics.ts
sources.finding: PostHog client initializes from a build-time key and sends events with a random device id, platform, arch and app version; no preference gates it.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/pty.ts
sources.finding: Terminals are backed by tmux sessions (or the node-pty sidecar on Windows) and are reconnected by id after the UI restarts.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/sidecar/protocol.ts
sources.finding: Sidecar keeps an 8 MiB ring buffer of terminal output per session for reconnect.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/git-replay-worker.ts
sources.finding: Read-only worker runs git log to build a commit replay for the workspace graph timeline; no commit, branch or PR writes.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/updater/update-manager.ts
sources.finding: electron-updater checks GitHub releases hourly, does not auto-download, installs on quit.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/ipc-browser.ts
sources.finding: Browser tile control (click, type, snapshot, screenshot, eval) is implemented over Chrome DevTools Protocol against embedded webviews.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/agent-activity.ts
sources.finding: In-memory map of agent sessions and the files each touched, relative to the workspace; no persistence of task state.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/workspace-config.ts
sources.finding: Workspace config stores an agent_skip_permissions flag (default false) that no pinned code path reads.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/windows/settings/src/App.tsx
sources.finding: Settings lists keyboard shortcuts for settings, find, navigator, terminal list, open workspace, zoom, full screen and tile focus; none concern review.

sources.title: collab-electron/src/main/ipc-filesystem.ts
sources.finding: Analytics events are file and UI actions (file_saved with extension, file_renamed, file_moved, file_trashed); other trackEvent callers are ipc-knowledge.ts, ipc-misc.ts and the app_crash handler in index.ts.
